decisions.decision: Keep sdar.telemetry-smpp-providerops-handoff/v2 as the formal Provider handoff unless additive compatibility is proven impossible.
Runtime mcp_task.remote_binding remains the only authority that selects Remote Task and Provider tuple.
Provider-internal execution relations may prove selected Provider Task -> Provider Execution but may not select a different Provider Task or override Runtime binding.
Origin, trace, correlation and generic relation hints remain non-authoritative for selection.
Exact Task->Execution closure is 0=unresolved, 1=exact, >1=conflict.
Dispatch uncertainty is a first-class state; uncertain is not failed.
An uncertain dispatch requires exact reconciliation before semantic readiness can become ready.
not_found/unavailable/deferred reconciliation does not prove no side effect; it remains unresolved readiness.
Provider completed/business success never proves Goal achieved or physical success.
Four terminal axes are control state, dispatch certainty, provider execution state and provider business outcome.
Physical verification remains downstream Benchmark responsibility.
No direct Provider private DB/HTTP collector will be added.
No direct writes to external_provider_fact/entity_relation_fact as test evidence.
No UGV-specific ClickHouse table will be introduced.
If generic Provider closure detail persistence is needed, use additive Telemetry-owned schema only; vendor 00..26 remains untouched.
Device Mission closure is optional until an authoritative producer contract exists.
observedAt is the freshness clock for state/position; projectedAt is not a substitute.
Closure snapshots are immutable; late evidence creates a new snapshot.
Manifest remains the only publication marker and is written after detail rows.
Same identity + same hash is idempotent; same identity + different hash is conflict.
Missing required evidence means not_ready/conflict as appropriate, never a metric score of zero.
This goal does not run vehicle_navigate or any physical side-effect command.
ProviderOps remains schema 1.1.0 / 16 record types if upstream confirms additive semantics.
Runtime canonical record types and payload fields must be taken from execution-time frozen registry, not guessed from this package.
No completion token unless every acceptance gate is proven PASS.
